original and final SHA-256 hashes are recorded
plain-text accessibility equivalent exists for every asset
no real private data, real phone numbers, real people, or real company impersonation
Mossfield world objects for required in-world gates are implemented in a disposable Paper server

shutdown route proves no post-shutdown Morrow message
database-bound worker delivers only authored G10 fragments

fresh production backup is verified before any production apply

release_rule: Do not change status to production_ready until every hard blocker has retained evidence and production_enabled remains false until a separately authorized launch action.
